rows.en: Access to Veda has been denied...!!
What!?
Who could have...
Ah...!! Don't tell me it's him...!!
There's only one who could do something like this: Reborns Gundam!!
Reborns Gundam...!! I see. So he's been pulling the strings...
It seems he has complete control over "Veda"... Tch!! When did he manage that!?
Everyone, listen to me. I'd like to propose an operation.
We "retake Veda."
I'll go to Veda itself and access its terminal directly. That way, we can take it back.
Hmm... Indeed, Veda may well hold the key to how this war unfolds from here.
We Kamen Riders will cooperate as well, of course.
Naturally. I'm in favor.
Very well. Then I approve this operation, and we'll put it into action at once.
First, use the Ride Machine to search for the Cube where Veda is.
The new drill is already installed. With it, you should now be able to break through sturdy walls.
Once you find the Cube, slip in fast, scout out the enemy, and pick the best tactics for the situation.
Seravee, this time I want you to infiltrate the Cube as well.
Roger.
...Seems they're gonna carry out some "plan" that blows way past the "Gaia Impact."
Wait a moment. Weren't Innovators the only ones who could access Veda?
...Reborns Gundam is an Innovator.
So the enemy has an Innovator too!!
...We Innovators are beings created to carry out Veda's orders.
What!?
Seravee, then you...
Please don't misunderstand. I've broken with them.
Not for Veda's sake, but to stay true to the justice I believe in.
Understood. I'll trust you. You are an irreplaceable comrade to us.
Thank you.
So for now, all we know for sure is that the enemy is using Veda to carry out some kind of "plan."
But whatever that plan may be... I will destroy it!!
Just then...
What!!
What happened!!
Hikari!! Report the situation!!
...It looks like we took a direct hit from a beam cannon. One of the facilities... has been wiped out.
Wh-What!?
It's all right. Luckily, it was a facility we weren't using. If it had hit us here, it would've been over.
We can't relax yet. A second shot is sure to come!!
Indeed. Next time they'll make sure to hit us... What's the state of the base's defenses?
We should be able to use the "Capture Cube."
The "Capture Cube"...?
It's a barrier that makes use of Meteor.
Right. But it's never been tested. I can't say how much it'll stop...
Hikari, can you tell what type of beam the enemy fired?
Most likely a GN particle cannon powered by a GN Drive Tau... and an enormous one, at that.
GN particles...!!
Where was it fired from?
Yes, I've pinpointed the coordinates. I've also spotted an object that looks like a Cube.
...That's it! Veda must be in that Cube!!
That saves us the trouble of searching for it!!
Let's head out right now!! We've gotta stop it first, right!? That second shot!!
But a Cube armed with a weapon of destruction like that... its defenses must be formidable too...
Hey! There's no time to sit around thinking!!
Then let's call in our Celestial Being pals. Looks like it's time to concentrate our forces here.
The Gundam unit in the "Desert Cube," huh... Yes, let's summon them at once.
I'm not waiting around for them!
I know. You'll be the advance team. Sortie at once.
Secure a route for Celestial Being, who'll follow behind you, and stop that second shot.
Roger!!
Seravee, infiltrate along with the advance team and carry out the recapture of Veda at the same time.
Roger.
I've had a good look around the inside of the base.
This place... Some of the "Item Lab" functions were dead, but I've repaired them.
It's the "Equipment Upgrade" function.
Haro explain Equipment Upgrade! Haro explain Equipment Upgrade!
View the Equipment Upgrade tutorial?
Welcome!
Huh? Can't you tell just by looking? This is the "Quest Room."
But it's a little different from your ordinary cafe, you know? It goes by the name "Quest Room."
Info on personal requests and hidden incidents, in other words "quests," all comes in here.
Solving them is up to you heroes, of course. You get a reward in exchange for completing a request.
Taking one on is easy. Just pick whichever quest you like from the list.
New quests come in little by little, so check back often, okay?
Sounds like they've set up somethin' called a "Quest Room."
What on earth is going on?
A new gate suddenly appeared.
It's not the Hideout Cube either... It seems to lead to a completely different Cube.

notes.note: All speakers verified against Event/Base/Command/0920.bla (MessWinSet offset+N -> entry N+1); labels match. Play order: 1-3, 33 (Ankh), 4-14, 37-48, 15-22, then 56-87.
Rows 24-27 are never called by the script (unused). Read as Zoffy briefing (24-26) and Seravee acknowledging (27).
Ankh, played between rows 3 and 4, right after Philip says the enemy installed the Memory of the Earth into Veda. Subject inferred as the enemy (they).
Meteor = the GUYS Meteor technology (glossary: Meteor cartridge).
Glossary term GN Drive Tau used for the pseudo Solar Furnace (some earlier slices wrote pseudo-Solar Furnace).
Haro: chirpy robot grammar. Equipment Upgrade follows system_024/system_056.
Unused row (not called by Quest/0923.bla); voiced as Urataros, an alternate intro line.
The new gate leads somewhere other than the Hideout Cube, to an entirely separate Cube (the Random Cube, per story_187).

report: All 80 rows translated; speakers verified against event scripts 0920/0921/0923/0924/0925 (no shifted labels). No identical earlier scene found to reuse. Unused rows: 0920 #24-27, 0923 #3 (speakers inferred). No new names.
